singlePurpose: VideoTracker saves and restores video watch progress across websites. Local recording requires no account. Optional end-to-end encrypted sync keeps records and site exclusions across devices. Users may voluntarily report problems with this functionality through a consent-based feedback form.
perm-storage: chrome.storage.local stores viewing records (URLs, titles, playback positions, durations, viewing timestamps and thumbnail URLs), site exclusions, deletion markers, preferences, login sessions, a remembered sync data key and feedback consent choice. Records are local by default. Sign-in sends account credentials over HTTPS to Supabase Auth; optional sync uploads device-encrypted records and rules. The sync encryption password is not uploaded. Confirmed feedback is separate from encrypted sync.
perm-activeTab: After users click the extension or invoke the manual-save shortcut, activeTab provides temporary access to identify the current video and save its page URL, title and playback progress. Manual saving works even when automatic recording is off or the site is excluded. Automatic recording separately relies on host access and content scripts.
perm-tabs: tabs reads relevant tab URLs and titles to associate embedded-player progress with the correct top-level page and identify relevant tabs during third-party sign-in. Tab APIs also open saved video pages and communicate with packaged content scripts. The extension does not collect a general log of all visited pages.
perm-scripting: Packaged content scripts and chrome.scripting.executeScript detect video elements, currentTime, duration and embedded-frame player state. Packaged player bridges may run in the MAIN world. Recording reads related video titles, URLs and thumbnails. Resume adjusts supported players to saved positions, and manual selection or resume prompts add on-page interaction controls. No remote executable code is loaded.
perm-identity: chrome.identity.getRedirectURL generates the extension callback address, and launchWebAuthFlow opens user-chosen Google or GitHub authorization. Supabase Auth processes account and session information; session tokens are stored locally. Optional sync uses the developer-configured Supabase service. Local recording needs no account; email/password login does not require identity. Feedback also works without sign-in.
host-perm-justification: *://*/* supports video detection and playback restoration on Bilibili, YouTube, iQIYI, Tencent Video, other compatible HTML5 sites and embedded-player domains that cannot all be listed in advance. Scripts read video URL/title/thumbnail, playback position and duration and restore supported players. Users can disable automatic recording globally or exclude domains and subdomains; manual saving remains available. These controls do not revoke browser host access. Unrelated browsing history is not recorded.
